observations.heading: Land and livelihoods
observations.finding: Human Rights Watch reported Aeta Hungey and farming-community concerns in Capas, including relocation, ancestral-domain claims, and access to land and water.
observations.limit: These are documented fieldwork findings and reported accounts, not a final judicial determination. Project boundaries, consultation records, and legal remedies require further verification.

observations.heading: Framework and sovereignty
observations.finding: At a November 11 House hearing, BCDA stated that Philippine law would govern the proposed hub and that the bilateral framework was still under negotiation.
observations.limit: This is an attributed agency position reported by GMA News. A final signed agreement and its enforceable terms have not been reviewed here.
